articles.title: Refunds within 30 days
articles.answer: If you cancel within 30 days of purchase you get a full refund to your original payment method, no questions asked.

articles.title: Refunds after 30 days
articles.answer: After 30 days we don't issue cash refunds; instead we credit the unused part of your subscription to your account.

articles.title: Reset your password
articles.answer: Click 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page and follow the link we email you; the link expires after 1 hour.

articles.title: Change your account email
articles.answer: Go to Settings > Account > Email, enter the new address and confirm it from the verification email.

articles.title: Export your notes
articles.answer: Use File > Export to download notes as Markdown or PDF; exporting a whole notebook produces a ZIP file.

articles.title: Import from Evernote
articles.answer: Export an .enex file from Evernote, then use File > Import > Evernote in Nimbus; tags and attachments are kept.
